name: hw12_11_inverted_ranges
description: Test 11 (HW6). Points on days 10, 20, 30, 40 (values 1, 2, 3, 4). With from > to no point can begin the range. Widened, after the two pre-checks, the walk stops at the first point after to, and the range is that point and its predecessor: from 35, to 15 gives days 10 and 20 (GetCount 2). from 50, to 45 is after the last point: the last point (1). from 8, to 5 is before the first point: the first point (1). GetMinMaxAverage(35, 15) reads no point (its range is not widened, so empty) and adds GetPoint(35) and GetPoint(15): GetPoint(35) is the line through days 30 and 40 at 35 (3.5), GetPoint(15) the line through days 10 and 20 at 15 (1.5): min 1.5, max 3.5, avg 2.5. GetTrend(35, 15) is the line through days 10 and 20 with base 35: slope 0.1, value at 35 = 3.5 at 53 bits.
